limitations: Current epic type is used only to select dataset locators; historical model fields are reconstructed independently.
A one-day review window may have little recoverable scope; inspect drafts before labelling.
Grouping catches shared observed plan tickets, not semantic duplicates.
Ratios are approximate when boundaries or exclusions affect counts.

Held-out cutoff plans are not reconstructed or emitted. Their roots and all-time observed members are withheld from development prior evidence, including prior scope reconstruction containing those references. HistoricalReader still loads underlying source records internally for historical reconstruction. Cross-partition exclusion uses membership reference metadata and can conservatively exclude memberships absent at a review cutoff.
